ability_mae.description: Mean absolute error between the reported ability and the evaluator-owned whole-bank WLE ability target, over every evaluator instance of the split. A failed slot is assigned at least the error of a constant guess (median target) and at least 2x the Random100 error.

ability_se.description: Standard error of the per-instance absolute ability errors (stability across models).

avg_items.description: Mean number of item queries per instance, counted by the evaluator's response oracle. Constraint, not scored: a slot whose average exceeds its evaluator-fixed budget (eval/*/budgets.json) fails.

information_efficiency_score.description: Diagnostic only (paper Eq. 4): ability MAE x avg_items / (Random100 ability MAE x 100), with Random100 computed by the evaluator on the same instances. Not scored because the product rewards near-empty tests; item cost is enforced by the slot budget instead.

accuracy_mae.description: Mean absolute gap between p-IRT reconstructed accuracy (observed responses on queried items + 3PL predictions from the reported ability elsewhere, evaluator-owned item bank) and the full-bank raw accuracy.

accuracy_se.description: Standard error of the per-instance absolute accuracy-reconstruction errors.

test_overlap_rate.description: Paper Eq. 7 test overlap rate over the queried item sets: expected share of common items between two instances' tests (1.0 for a fixed form).

average_item_exposure_rate.description: Paper Eq. 5-6 average exposure rate taken over the items queried for at least one instance: mean fraction of instances that saw each used item (1.0 for a fixed form). Measures concentration of item use.

models_evaluated.description: Number of instances with a valid ability estimate (diagnostic).

constraint_failed.description: Diagnostic: 1 if the slot failed (protocol error, impossible estimate, missing claim, budget exceeded, ability MAE above 2x Random100, or accuracy reconstruction worse than a constant guess), else 0. Failure is already reflected in the scored metrics.

winogrande_reduced_item_ability._note: Setup: the gym scores every released model identity of the paper's response matrices, split 50/50 by a name hash (held-out half = hidden test, ~1.7k-2.3k models per benchmark) instead of the paper's 10% stratified test split.
